title: Reconcile SRD table parser scope with canonical output
description:
﻿Reconcile D&D SRD 5.1 table parser documentation, tests, and canonical generated output.

Problem:
The importer README documents table coverage beyond Difficulty Classes, including XP Thresholds by Character Level and treasure tables, but the committed canonical pack contains only one table record: table:difficulty-classes. This is either an importer coverage bug or stale documentation/scope.

Scope:
- Review the vendored SRD 5.1 PDF table content against the documented table parser scope.
- Decide based on existing ADR/importer intent whether XP thresholds and treasure tables should be imported as table records.
- If they are in scope, fix the table parser and regenerate the canonical pack.
- If they are out of scope, update README/tests/baselines to stop claiming they are covered.
- Prefer importing documented in-scope tables rather than silently narrowing scope.

Acceptance criteria:
- README table coverage accurately matches the committed canonical pack.
- table parser tests cover every table family claimed as supported.
- Canonical records include all table records claimed by the README.
- Add reviewed table count/key baselines so table coverage cannot silently collapse.
- npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack exits 0.
- npm run audit:rules-pack -- packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1 reports no new suspicious findings.
- npm run check, npm run typecheck, and npm test pass.
- Do not change source vendoring policy.
- Do not add unrelated parser fixes.
close_reason: Resolved as stale documentation: SRD 5.1 PDF contains only the Difficulty Classes reference table (p77); XP-threshold and treasure tables are non-SRD content absent from the source. README/test-header docs corrected, table key/name regression baseline added. verify:dnd5e-srd-pack=0, audit suspicious=0, check/typecheck/test pass.
